template.title: The Kite That Learned to Sing
template.summary: A child, a pet, and a bright kite find a gentle way to solve a small problem and celebrate together.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_pet]] and a [[slot_toy]] in the [[slot_place]].
The [[slot_toy]] was bright [[slot_color]] and danced in the [[slot_weather]] sky.
One day, the kite got stuck high in a tall tree.
[[slot_child]] looked up and felt a little sad.
[[slot_child]] thought about climbing the tree, but then remembered that [[slot_pet]] liked to hop.
Instead of climbing, [[slot_child]] sang a gentle song to the kite.
The kite twitched and, with a soft sigh, fell back to the ground.
[[slot_child]] felt happy when the kite flew again.
They played hop and chase with the kite for a long time.
When the sun began to set, [[slot_child]] tucked the kite into a basket.
The backyard looked peaceful, and [[slot_child]] felt calm.
[[slot_child]] thanked the wind for the gentle breeze.
They all went home, dreaming of bright colors.
The next day, the kite was ready for another adventure.
